chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch.58 — Ji Ning Activates the 5th Layer of the Legendary Lesser Thousand Sword Formation
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns the Lesser Thousand Sword Formation, requiring 729 flying swords. With his monstrous soul power, he achieves the fifth layer on his first try, stunning the Black Ox.
og_title: A Sword Array That Defies Logic: Ji Ning's First Step to Dominance
og_description: The inheritance is real. Ji Ning carves ancient runes onto 729 swords and awakens the fearsome fifth-layer sword-light.
twitter_title: Ji Ning just pulled off the impossible: 5 layers of the Lesser Thousand Sword Formation on his first try.
twitter_description: 729 swords, ancient runes, and a soul that makes even immortal artifact spirits gasp. This is how a true prodigy trains.
